# Corbel

> Claude Code plugin and stdio MCP server for the Procore REST API. Unofficial. Read-only by default.

- [README](README.md): install, tools, configuration
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repo layout, rules and Procore concepts for AI agents
- [Domain guide skill](skills/procore-domain-guide/SKILL.md): how Procore data is organized and how to call the tools
- [Standards](docs/standards.md): the Anthropic directory checklist this repo is held to
- [Other MCP clients](docs/other-clients.md): Cursor and generic setup
- [Security](SECURITY.md) and [Privacy](PRIVACY.md)
- Endpoint index: spec/index/manifest.json lists the shards of 3,300+ Procore operations
